title: GEMS-RAG: Graph-grounded Engineering Multimodal Standards Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Engineering standards are challenging knowledge sources for large language models (LLMs) because they are hierarchical, multimodal, and densely connected through figures, tables, cross-references, and normative rules. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods often rely on unstructured text retrieval and struggle with questions requiring joint reasoning over textual provisions, visual specifications, and document structure. We propose GEMS-RAG (Graph-grounded Engineering Multimodal Standards Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a framework for grounded reasoning over engineering standards. GEMS-RAG combines hierarchical parsing, fine-grained visual entity extraction, multimodal knowledge graph construction, and graph-grounded hybrid retrieval. translated_title: GEMS-RAG：基于图锚定的工程多模态标准检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 工程标准对大语言模型（LLM）来说是具有挑战性的知识来源，因为它们是分层组织的、多模态的，并且通过图表、表格、交叉引用和规范规则密集连接。现有的检索增强生成（RAG）方法通常依赖非结构化文本检索，难以处理需要对文本条款、视觉规范和文档结构进行联合推理的问题。我们提出了GEMS-RAG（基于图锚定的工程多模态标准检索增强生成），这是一个面向工程标准有据推理的框架。GEMS-RAG结合了分层解析、细粒度视觉实体提取、多模态知识图谱构建以及基于图的混合检索。它没有将图表视为单一的整体图像，而是将其分解为有意义的视觉实体，并将其与文本条款、工程概念和规范规则相关联。在推理过程中（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: GEMS-RAG通过将工程标准中的图表分解为细粒度视觉实体并构建多模态知识图谱，结合基于图的混合检索，实现了对文本条款、视觉规范和文档结构的联合有据推理。
en_tdlr: GEMS-RAG decomposes figures into fine-grained visual entities linked to textual provisions and builds a multimodal knowledge graph, enabling graph-grounded hybrid retrieval for joint reasoning over engineering standards.
